news.title: Consumer apprehension grows as US retailers adopt AI-assisted pricing tools
news.summary: U.S. consumers aren't just frustrated with high prices. They're angry and confused about the increasingly high-tech ways that restaurant chains and major retailers are setting those prices.

news.title: TinyFish Makes Search Free: What It Really Costs an AI Agent to Read the Web
news.summary: An AI agent that reads the web pays 2 kinds of cost. The first is the retrieval charge: what a search or fetch API bills per request. The second is model processing: content passed from retrieved pages into an AI model consumes tokens, while reasoning and generated responses add further costs. news.title: Switching languages can change a chatbot's personality test results
news.summary: Ask an AI chatbot to complete a personality questionnaire in English, then give it the Mandarin version, and its answers paint a different picture. In tests of five systems, switching languages changed how strongly the responses expressed qualities such as curiosity, cooperativeness and dependability.

news.title: Japan's MMX mission aims to swipe soil samples from Mars's moon Phobos
news.summary: A Japanese space mission is about to launch towards Mars. But it will not land on the planet itself. Instead, the Martian Moons Exploration (MMX) mission will focus on Phobos, the bigger of Mars's two small moons.

news.title: Japan to launch spacecraft on a mission to get samples from a Martian moon
news.summary: Japan is set to launch a spacecraft on the world's first mission to bring back samples from Phobos, one of the two small, potato-shaped moons orbiting Mars.

news.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
news.summary: Google Research released Harness2, an Apache-2.0 framework that rewrites an agent's harness at test time. One refinement step lifted GLM-5 by 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench with no weight updates.
